item: R7 - final zeroing across module graph, package graph, artifacts and in-use commands, compared against the frozen baseline
candidate: the commit that introduces this file; its SHA together with the final make verify-gpu exit code is written to migration/handoff.json under phase_E_T15_final, and the sweep itself ran against that tree with a clean working directory

module_level.note_on_the_error_keyword_grep: a keyword scan for 'error' over the module list matches module names only (hashicorp/go-multierror, pkg/errors, golang.org/x/xerrors, olekukonko/errors); both go commands wrote zero bytes to stderr, so nothing was swallowed and nothing was ignored to reach a clean count

package_level_per_build_tag.generated_integration_sample_included_se: the protoc sample package under testdata/integration is not part of ./... (verified: go list ./pkg/... returns 0 matches for it), so it was scanned on its own in migration/patches/T15/T15-redact-runtime-dependency.json: 313 packages, 7 modules, zero tx7do, both with and without -test

artifact_buildinfo.checked_with: go version -m on the binary actually produced by the in-use command

results.app/admin/service/cmd/server: module go-wind-admin, tx7do deps 0, sha256 5458e7ba63f0271a (built in this round)
results.app/admin/service/cmd/admin: module go-wind-admin, tx7do deps 0, sha256 661f469bb3fcaccb (built in this round)
results.tools/bin/gow from make gow: module go-wind-admin, tx7do deps 0, sha256 e7ccdf75c1948a31, identical to the private binary used in the two-order Ent proof
results.tools/bin/protoc-gen-go-redact: module go-wind-admin, tx7do deps 0, sha256 bd499076ca729ea1, built by scripts/build-redact-plugin.sh from pkg/localdeps
results.counter_example_for_the_reader: the legacy R5 probe built from the frozen baseline reports two tx7do deps in the same field, so a zero here is a measurement and not a reporting artefact

in_use_commands.no_external_gow_install: make gow builds tools/localdeps/gow/cmd/gow from this module; the Makefile states plainly that gow is no longer installed from github.com/tx7do
in_use_commands.no_go_install_of_tx7do: scripts/build-redact-plugin.sh replaced the former go install of the upstream redact plugin with a local go build, and api/buf.gen.yaml calls ../tools/bin/protoc-gen-go-redact by path
in_use_commands.go_install_hits_are_pinned_dev_tools: make plugin and make cli install protoc-gen-go v1.36.11, protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.6.2, protoc-gen-go-http/errors, gnostic, buf v1.60.0 and ent v0.14.6 at pinned versions; none is a tx7do module, and neither target is part of make verify-gpu
in_use_commands.no_latest_no_tidy_no_automatic_dep_updat: no @latest anywhere in Makefile or scripts; the taken-over gow had its automatic go mod tidy removed and fails instead of running buf dep update or installing a tool
in_use_commands.explicitly_unresolved_and_announced: make cli prints that the kratos CLI and golangci-lint are not pinned because neither binary is present to verify (migration/patches/T15/T15-tool-lock.json unresolved_entries); no command pretends to run them

structure.nested_module_explained: the T09 entry is the throwaway 't09desc' descriptor-comparison harness recorded in migration/receipts/T09.json line 104; it sits under the ledger, is excluded from ./..., and its protobuf v1.36.12 requirement cannot affect the main module, which resolves v1.36.11
structure.history_and_licensing_copies_not_counted: third_party/tx7do/** (SHA256SUMS-manifested source backup), the locked zips, migration/patches/*/_orig and *_pristine copies and LICENSE/NOTICE files are reference material, not resolved dependencies, and are excluded from the dependency claim in this way deliberately

baseline_version_discipline.method: go list -m all was run twice for real - once on the final tree, once on a scratch directory holding only go.mod and go.sum extracted from the frozen baseline d27847b - and the two module sets were compared entry by entry, rather than inferring equality from go.mod being textually unchanged
baseline_version_discipline.removal_attribution: the 42 tx7do modules plus github.com/gobwas/glob and github.com/google/cel-go, which go mod graph showed at T14 as pulled only by go-utils v1.1.40 and kratos-bootstrap/rpc v0.1.3

not_claimed_by_r7: R7 proves dependency and artifact zeroing plus unchanged surviving versions; it is not behavioural acceptance, which is what R4 and R5 carry
the final make verify-gpu over this candidate is a separate record and its exit code governs
R6 remains blocked on the missing historical dumps, so the task conclusion stays qualified regardless of this sweep
